corpus.purpose: Tokenizer-research corpus foundation (Project 004 Stage A). No tokenizer has been selected here, and nothing in this corpus selects one.

targets.note: Targets from the Project 004 design audit. They are goals, not quotas: a slot below target is reported as INSUFFICIENT with the real amount, never padded.

split.note: Each document is assigned by sha256('<seed>:<doc_id>') < heldout_fraction. No global RNG, so the split is reproducible and independent of document order.

cleaning_policy: prepare_source_text (kind-specific wrapper/markup removal only: Gutenberg header/footer; wikitext markup; for mediawiki-parse, MediaWiki's rendered HTML minus what Wikisource marks ws-noexport (header template, hidden metadata, page anchors), <style>/<script>, footnote markers/lists and display:none elements - see frontier_ai.data.mediawiki). The mediawiki-parse cleaner also removes three invisible rendering artifacts (U+200B, U+2060, U+FEFF) and turns U+00A0 into a space, recording the counts in provenance; U+200C/U+200D (ZWNJ/ZWJ) are kept. It also drops the verbatim residue of a mistyped {{gap}} template that MediaWiki printed as text ({{Gap{}, {{Gap}], {{Gap]}, {Gap}}, {{Gap)), {{Gap@)), {{Gap before the text, <gap>): a correct {{gap}} renders as a removed U+2060 spacer, so the result is the text a correctly typed page gives (counted as 'broken {{gap}} template -> removed'). Likewise it drops a red link that MediaWiki prints for a template that does not exist (a misspelt name, e.g. साँचा:GaP; only redlink=1 links into the Template namespace, counted per template as 'link to missing template <title> -> removed') and a '}}' that closes nothing on a line without '{' or '|' ('stray }} -> removed'). Everything else odd stays in the text for the inspection report. Unicode normalization is NOT applied; NFC/NFD/NFKC experiments belong to a later Project 004 stage.

sources.title: Sadhana: The Realisation of Life
sources.attribution: Sadhana: The Realisation of Life by Rabindranath Tagore (first published 1913; the Gutenberg text follows the 1916 printing), text from Project Gutenberg (ebook 6842, produced by Chetan Jain at BharatLiterature). Public domain in the United States; Tagore died in 1941, so the work is also public domain in India. Used here as a tokenizer-research fixture, not as a redistribution.
sources.notes: Second English source: Alice alone is 144,599 characters, below the 200,000-character target. Chosen for genre diversity (philosophical essays, non-fiction, next to a children's novel) and for Indian English: Upanishadic terms, Indian names and romanised Sanskrit with diacritics (Sādhanā, Daurbhikshāt …). Checked on 2026-09-24: gutenberg.org/ebooks/6842 lists it as 'Public domain in the USA' (plain text 226 kB); pg6842.txt carries the standard '*** START/END OF THE PROJECT GUTENBERG EBOOK SADHANA : THE REALISATION OF LIFE ***' markers, the text begins with the author's preface and ends with chapter VIII ('…not distant, not anywhere else.'). The header/footer is stripped by clean_gutenberg_text(), which keeps everything between the markers — so the cleaned text starts with the producer's credit line 'Produced by Chetan Jain at BharatLiterature' (43 characters, accepted) and the 1916 title page; the licence marker is the payload's own Project Gutenberg header. Hash is pinned only after a verified fetch.
